description: This file contains implementation of fused stochastic gradient descent (SGD) kernels optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend, including functions for performing SGD with optional momentum and interaction with tensor parameters. It defines kernel functions, applies multi-tensor operations, and includes checks for device contexts and input validity.

methods.name: _fused_sgd_with_momentum_kernel_mps_
methods.description: Performs fused SGD with momentum on MPS backend, dispatching based on whether the learning rate tensor is on CPU or GPU.

methods.name: _fused_sgd_kernel_mps_
methods.description: Main kernel function for fused SGD optimized for MPS, handling cases with and without momentum buffers and different device contexts.
